label: ml_analysis_media_assets
query:
SELECT mus.status
        FROM ml.analysis_media_assets va
        LEFT JOIN ml.analysis_media_upload_sessions mus
          ON mus.id::text = coalesce(va.source_json->>$1, $2)
        WHERE va.id = $3
        LIMIT $4

label: ml_analysis_media_cast_candidates
query:
SELECT
          vacc.person_id::text AS person_id,
          p.full_name AS display_name,
          vacc.source,
          vacc.confidence,
          vacc.credit_category,
          vacc.billing_order,
          vacc.role
        FROM ml.analysis_media_cast_candidates vacc
        JOIN core.people p ON p.id = vacc.person_id
        WHERE vacc.video_asset_id = $1
        ORDER BY vacc.billing_order NULLS LAST, p.full_name ASC

label: ml_screentime_review_state
query: DELETE FROM ml.screentime_review_state WHERE run_id = $1 AND review_kind = $2

label: pipeline
query: SELECT * FROM pipeline.socialblade_growth_data WHERE person_id = $1 AND instagram_handle = $2

label: pipeline
query:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY platform, account_handle
      ORDER BY updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, created_at DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM pipeline.socialblade_growth_data
)
DELETE FROM pipeline.socialblade_growth_data target
USING ranked
WHERE target.id = ranked.id
  AND ranked.rn > $1

label: pipeline
query:
select person_id::text, instagram_handle, scraped_at,
coalesce(jsonb_array_length(daily_total_followers_chart->$1), $2) as chart_points,
daily_total_followers_chart->$3 as date_range
from pipeline.socialblade_growth_data
where person_id = $4
  and instagram_handle = $5

label: screenalytics_face_bank_images
query:
SELECT
                      f.person_id::text AS person_id,
                      p.full_name AS person_name,
                      f.s3_embedding_key
                    FROM screenalytics.face_bank_images AS f
                    JOIN core.people AS p
                      ON p.id = f.person_id
                    WHERE f.approved = $1
                      AND f.is_seed = $2
                      AND f.s3_embedding_key IS NOT NULL
                    ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
                    LIMIT $3
